title: Base Read File Record variant 5
purpose: Cover the file-record service with one compact subrequest for file 1, record 0, and a two-register record length.

messages.label: Read File Record request with one subrequest

expected_behavior: A conforming server may parse the single file-record subrequest and return the requested record data, or return a standard exception if the addressed file or record is unsupported.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 000a equals the unit identifier plus the 9-byte function-14 PDU.
The function-14 byte count 07 matches the one 7-byte subrequest.
Reference type 06, file number 0001, record number 0000, and record length 0002 are consistently encoded.
issue_safety_notes: No external vulnerability or issue knowledge is available. The message is a conservative function-coverage candidate based on model-prior protocol plausibility.
